event: Confirmed in the cptra test; the MCU side only polls nonzero and reads into a variable. Let me check quickly.

I submitted the verdict as verified: the finding stands.

In `cptra_ss_mcu_mbox_test.c`, the "Checking MBOX USER INFO" step reads the MBOX USER register and only prints it. Nothing compares the value to an expected user, so the test cannot fail on it.

The MCU-side test, `smoke_test_mcu_mbox.c`, only polls until USER is nonzero and then prints it. That is a weak check that the field is set, not a check of which user holds the lock.

I did not search for another test that covers the plan item.
